# contabo_dns_zone (Data Source)

Look up a DNS zone hosted on the Contabo name servers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure your Contabo API credentials
provider "contabo" {
  oauth2_client_id     = "[your client id]"
  oauth2_client_secret = "[your client secret]"
  oauth2_user          = "[your username]"
  oauth2_pass          = "[your password]"
}

# Get a DNS zone by name
data "contabo_dns_zone" "example" {
  zone_name = "example.com"
}

output "name_servers" {
  value = data.contabo_dns_zone.example.name_servers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_name` (String) The name of the zone, e.g. `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier of the DNS zone, which is the zone name.
- `name_servers` (List of String) The name servers authoritative for the zone.
